# spytLabs

> spytLabs (spytLabs (PVT) LTD) is a studio in Colombo, Sri Lanka offering design, video production, software development and AI automation, delivered by one team.

Contact: hello@spytlabs.com, +94 77 518 4773. Projects are quoted individually.

## Services

- [Web design and branding](https://www.spytlabs.com/design): UI/UX, motion and brand identity.
- [AI automation](https://www.spytlabs.com/automation): AI agents and workflows built on n8n, Make and custom APIs.
- [Video production](https://www.spytlabs.com/productions): commercials, social reels, event coverage, food and product videography, photoshoots.
- [Software development](https://www.spytlabs.com/technology): web platforms, mobile apps, systems and technical consulting.

## Work

- [Case studies](https://www.spytlabs.com/work): all published projects.
- [Colombo Literary Festival](https://www.spytlabs.com/work/colombo-literary-festival): 730,000 organic reel views across six festival days.
- [Spillburg Corporate Services](https://www.spytlabs.com/work/spillburg): a 15-page corporate website.
- [Vincent Pelle](https://www.spytlabs.com/work/vincent-pelle): store, courier and WhatsApp updates run from one order dashboard.
- [Sales outreach agent](https://www.spytlabs.com/work/sales-outreach-agent): an AI agent that replaced manual prospecting for a B2B services firm.
- [NinetyNine Restaurant & Lounge](https://www.spytlabs.com/work/ninetynine): food and drink videography.
